title: ENIAC electronic computer
summary: ENIAC was a programmable, general-purpose electronic digital computer.
interchange: Britain's Colossus (1944) and Germany's Z3 (1941) were developed separately

unsung.contribution: Six women programmed ENIAC, the first programmable electronic general-purpose computer.
unsung.recognition: Programming was seen as clerical; they were not publicly recognised, often getting no credit in their lifetimes.
